home.title: A workshop for production React.
home.body: This Vite app is the ReactLoom SPA: typed routes, a session guard, and one feature that talks to the network through TanStack Query.
home.api: Retries, timeouts, and normalized errors live in the shared API client.
home.query: Tasks use a query key factory, an optimistic mutation, and visible loading and error states.
home.a11y: Landmarks, labels, and axe checks ship with the template.

tasks.title: Warp board
tasks.body: Jobs for this session. The list is cached, and creating a task updates it before the response returns.
tasks.error: The task list could not be loaded.
